blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The Supreme Court (SC) is closely monitoring the ongoing investigation into the fatal shooting of a Basilan trial court judge in Zamboanga City, vowing to hold both the gunmen and the masterminds accountable while ordering heightened security measures across the judiciary. In a statement released Monday, Nov. 16, the high tribunal condemned the November 12 killing of Presiding Judge Joseph Wee Sit of the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 in Isabela City, Basilan, describing the ambush as “a direct assault on judicial independence and the rule of law.” “No judge should have to fear […]...
